points.description: Gives the correct domain [1/2, 4/3] (equivalently 1/2 ≤ x ≤ 4/3), with endpoints as common fractions, and every step is mathematically valid.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both a correct final domain and a fully valid solution. A single wrong step or an incorrect final answer earns 0 marks. Equivalent correct notation is accepted.
